card.name: Words just before 'nearby' type terms
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a phrase where a nearby/surrounding-type word or a related continuation could come next, such as 'within 50 miles', 'eye or surrounding', 'other drugs, including'. Scattered across label cross-references and web text.

modes.label: Distance and surroundings
modes.description: Words about distance or area that are followed by a place or neighbouring structure.
modes.example: 1.9 million people live within 50<< miles>> of the North Anna nuclear plant.

modes.description: Partway through a section name or drug-interaction sentence in a label.

card.writes: It suppresses nearby, surrounding and neighboring words, so it makes those less likely as the next word.
